messages:
Olivia (CS): Heads-up from onboarding with NorthField 1: recurring asks across finance and platform: (1) per-route cost numbers, (2) ability to lock an embedding model per-route, (3) a 1-page rollout checklist with example prompts. They said lack of per-route visibility is blocking seat expansion.

Sam (PM): Can you paste the exact lines they used and which routes they care about?

Olivia (CS): Verbatim snippets: 
- "We need per-endpoint cost so our internal billing works."
- "If embedding spend spikes, we need to pin a cheaper model for search."
- "A one-pager checklist with starter prompts would have cut our setup time."
They called out `notes-summarize` and `enterprise-search-embeds`.

Rory (Product): Thanks. Quick triage: checklist + prompts = immediate low-effort win. CSV export of per-route totals = short-term stopgap. UI + billing attribution = roadmap. Embedding-pin per-route = medium effort but high customer ROI.

Ben (Eng): For a stopgap we can add route_id to the billing agg and expose a simple CSV endpoint. Estimate: ~2 dev days. Embedding-pin = small metadata table + lookup in runtime, ~3 dev days. Full UI is multi-sprint. Example ad-hoc query we can run now:

SELECT route_id, DATE(ts) day, SUM(cost_cents) total_cents FROM billing_events WHERE account_id='northfield' GROUP BY route_id, day;

Olivia (CS): I'll collect audio clips and open a cs:feedback ticket with quotes. Recommend marking NorthField as at-risk if we don't deliver a CSV in 10 business days. Also requesting a one-pager for CSMs to share with the customer.

Sam (PM): Action items: Olivia opens ticket; Product drafts checklist; Eng scopes CSV + embed-pin and posts estimates. I'll mark CSV as P0 quick-win for retention.

AlertBot: JIRA ticket CS-6002 created by Olivia (CS) - "NorthField onboarding: per-route cost CSV + embed-pin + checklist" - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-6002

Ben (Eng): Adding CS-6002 to sprint buffer. Will post sample CSV and PR link here when ready.

Rory (Product): Drafting checklist now, will share for CS signoff by EOD.

Olivia (CS): Thanks everyone 1 :thumbsup: I'll update NorthField with the interim timeline and track renewal risk.
